reason: The cited evidence (E1, E3) supports that SPS produces dense material and that wear resistance increases at high temperature due to an oxide layer, but it does not identify the oxide as CrTaO4-based, nor does it provide evidence that oxidation/diffusion kinetics govern the layer formation or that optimizing SPS parameters enhances it.
premises: SPS processing of AlCoCrFeNiTi0.5 produces a dense bulk material with fine multiphase microstructure
Wear resistance of this HEA increases at elevated temperatures due to formation of a protective oxide layer
